description:
Run a whole browser goal with TypeSafe Jev and get one summary. Start with `url` (the page where the change is made, not a parent page) or `tab`; continue with `session`.
Statuses (`next` says what to do): done (`done_when` passed); needs_input (add the `missing` fields to `values`); needs_confirmation (the next click looks irreversible: see `confirm_irreversible`); uncertain / blocked (read `reason` and the screenshot; rephrase `goal` or use chrome-devtools; a `wall` is for the user to pass, never get past a bot check); step_budget (continue with a narrower goal).
Password fields are never typed: the user types them, then say so in `goal`. Closed shadow DOM, canvas: use chrome-devtools.

allow_coordinate_clicks.description: New session, opt-in: click a screenshot box no listed element matches (canvas).

allowed_hosts.description: Hosts the run may be on ("github.com", "*.example.com"); leaving ends it blocked.

checks.description: Facts code checks on the final page: url_contains, title_contains, text_contains, text_absent {text}; url_matches {pattern: glob}; element_exists {name, role?}; value_equals {label, value}; checked {label, state}; count_at_least {min, name?, role?}. A failure turns done into uncertain; [] clears.

confirm_irreversible.description: Allow one irreversible click, only when the user's own request names this action and its target ("unused repos" names none: ask). Only the control the needs_confirmation named, on the call answering it or a new session's first call.

confirm_target.description: The user's words naming the target ("ada/scratch"); the page must show them.

detail.description: full adds raw steps, confidences, Jev stats.

done_when.description: Visible proof of success on this call's end page; done needs it. Resend with a new goal.

files.description: Files the user asked to upload: key → absolute path or https URL.

goal.description: The whole outcome, every filter and choice.

record.description: New session: keep a video, step shots and index.html for people.

record_dir.description: New session: the run folder (recording on) goes here.

screenshot.description: Inline the final screenshot on done too.

secret_keys.description: Keys of values that are secrets: Jev sees only the key; results show [secret:<key>].

tab.description: New session on the open tab whose URL contains this.

totp.description: 2FA on the user's own account: key → authenticator secret (base32 or otpauth URI); the current code is typed.

url.description: New session in a background tab.

values.description: Every text Jev may type, by key: {"city":"Lisbon"}. Nothing else is typed.

wait_for_person_seconds.description: Wait for the user at a bot check or sign-in; default 120, 0 off.

name: jevway_task
title: Run a browser goal with Jev
